findings.title: Plugin request logs no longer include traceID
findings.body: In pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/logger_middleware.go line 49, logRequest builds logParams with only status, duration, eventName and time_before_plugin_request. The old code explicitly added traceID via tracing.TraceIDFromContext. The new code removed that and relies on m.logger.FromContext(ctx). The context enrichment in pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go instrumentContext only adds endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID, uname, never traceID. So traceID is silently dropped from 'Plugin Request Completed' logs, breaking trace-to-log correlation for plugin requests.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards logs
findings.body: In pkg/plugins/log/fake.go line 46, TestLogger.FromContext returns NewTestLogger(), a fresh empty logger, ignoring the receiver. The real implementation in pkg/plugins/log/logger.go returns a wrapper sharing the underlying sink with contextual attributes. After the change LoggerMiddleware does m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so the Info call lands on the throwaway object, not on the injected m.logger. Tests asserting on the original TestLogger's InfoLogs/WarnLogs will see zero calls, making the new logging path unobservable and untestable.

findings.title: ContextualLoggerMiddleware panics on nil request
findings.body: In pkg/services/pluginsintegration/clientmiddleware/contextual_logger_middleware.go line 40, QueryData (and similarly CallResource, CheckHealth, CollectMetrics) dereferences req.PluginContext without checking req for nil. The sibling LoggerMiddleware in the same package explicitly guards if req == nil before touching it, showing nil is considered possible. Since ContextualLoggerMiddleware is wired outer to LoggerMiddleware in pluginsintegration.go, a nil request panics with nil dereference before reaching Logger's guard, crashing the request path.

findings.title: FromContext silently drops context on type assertion failure
findings.body: In pkg/plugins/log/logger.go line 48, grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext asserts d.l.FromContext(ctx) to *log.ConcreteLogger and on failure returns d.New(), a fresh logger with no contextual attributes. That silently discards endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname added by ContextualLoggerMiddleware, with no error or fallback to the original logger. If the infra logger ever returns a different Logger implementation, plugin request logs lose all context invisibly.
